notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.notes:
Hotfix 4

[list]
[*] Minor adjustments to swim speed for faster movement.
[*] Small tweak to one of the class bird's attacks.
[*] Minor fixes to UI bugs.
[*] Birds will no longer get stuck in the clouds.
[*] Reduced the countdown timer for the next bird wave.
[*] Disabled the demo timer.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.notes:
Hotfix 3

[list]
[*] Fixed the UI options for co-op to work correctly.
[*] Fixed the link button in the high score UI.
[*] Fixed a cinematic issue with one of the class birds.
[/list]

[list]
[*] working on allowing support for one gamepad and one keyboard
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Hotfixes Implemented

[list]
[*] Fixed invulnerable tiles bug.
[*] Resolved an issue with the dynamic sound system.
[*] Removed random debug messages appearing on screen.
[*] Updated gamepad sensitivity.
[*] Fixed a bug where the guano stream from one of the class birds did not destroy itself.
[*] Adjusted loud sound in the ending cinematic.
[/list]

Fixes to Look Into

[list]
[*] The shopkeeper is vibrating.
[*] Points of interest for players.
[*] UI option for two-player mode.
[*] Support for using only one gamepad and one keyboard to play.
[*] Text size adjustments.
[*] High score tracking for both players.
[*] Cinematic skip option assigned to a designated player.
[*] Adjusting spawn time when a player has drowned.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921895/071bb9faaf7148192fff0783a082e28ed92fd526.png[/img]Fixes for Hotfix 1

We've implemented new fixes in the latest hotfix.

[list]
[*]The Rogue card will now appear correctly.
[*]You can no longer swim through the buoy in the water.
[*]The female character now has a proper female voice.
[*]Links in the main menu are now direct links to the correct website instead of QR codes.
[*]The water pump is now easier to hit when it needs repairs.
[*]Music will now play correctly.
[*]Minor sound fixes.
[/list]

Fixes we are looking Into
[list]
[*]The shopkeeper is vibrating.
[*]Points of interest for players.
[*]UI option for two-player mode.
[*]Support for using only one gamepad and one keyboard to play.
[*]Text size adjustments.
[*]High score tracking for both players.
[*]Cinematic skip option assigned to a designated player.
[*]Adjusting spawn time when a player has drowned.
[/list]
